cross_verification.note_en: Fetched and full-text-searched the official Tonga Passport Regulations (Cap. 25.08.1, 2016 Revised Edition, ago.gov.to — Tonga's Attorney General's Office legislation repository) directly. The regulation requires 'two recent photographs of the applicant, endorsed with the words "I certify this is a true likeness of (applicant's name)" on the reverse of the photograph and signed by' a qualifying witness (minister of religion, law practitioner, magistrate, public servant, medical practitioner, etc. who has known the applicant 12+ months). A full-text search of the entire 17-page regulation for 'mm', 'cm', 'inch', 'size', and 'background' returned no matches — Tonga's primary law does not specify numeric photo dimensions, background colour, or head-height, relying instead on a personal-witness certification system rather than ICAO biometric measurement standards. Because no official numeric spec exists to verify or refute, technical fields are left unverified rather than filled with third-party estimates.
